title: Integration funnel checkpoint — weekly sync (2025-05-06)
content:
Attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Samir, Evelyn
Duration: 40m (tight) — quick triage format
Objective: Surface integration pipeline health, escalate customer blockers, confirm next-week runway and capacity needs.

1) Quick pulse (30s each)
- Maya: overall funnel steady; three customers entering deployment stage this week (Nebula Health, ArgosPay, TidalAnalytics). Need final capacity confirmations for Nebula.
- Diego: observability hooks work for ArgosPay but trace sampling config causing noisy traces.
- Priya: docs pass for TidalAnalytics but test harness failing on long-context embeddings in staging.
- Samir: automation for onboarding checkpoints (scripts) needs small patch — PR ready, awaiting reviews.
- Evelyn: proserv capacity booking: two senior SEs available week of 5/19; need to assign to Nebula pre-prod run.

2) Customer statuses (detailed)
- Nebula Health (priority: HIPAA, go-live target 2025-05-21)
  - Current phase: private deployment prep + compliance review.
  - Open blockers: KMS rotation policy mismatch with their security team (SE-2345). They require HSM-backed key envelopes; our current private deploy template uses cloud KMS.
  - Temporary mitigation: document in-constraining decision tree, schedule deep-dive with security (Maya + Evelyn) for 5/08.
  - Action items: Evelyn to schedule security sync; Diego to draft HSM integration runbook excerpt by 5/09; Priya to update onboarding checklist (item: KMS/HSM decision matrix).
  - Risk: medium-high — if HSM integration needs engineering changes, push to Dedicated/private Q3 timeline.

- ArgosPay (priority: low-latency payments fraud detection)
  - Current phase: model validation in staging.
  - Open blockers: trace sampling causing >40% of error events masked; need higher-fidelity traces for model rerank debugging.
  - Workaround: enable full traces for specific routes and use prefix caching to reduce noise. Diego to implement route-specific sampling toggle by 5/08.
  - Action items: Samir to run focused rerank test suite (two runs) and upload results to Confluence under onboarding-runbook-482.
  - Note: latency SLOs currently at 280ms p95 on staging; target 200ms for production. Plan: tune batching and enable KV cache for warm-up.

- TidalAnalytics (priority: embeddings-heavy, research pilot)
  - Current phase: bench and quantization experiment.
  - Open blockers: test harness fails at 10k tokens due to memory spike in our quantized path. Priya suspects kernel selection mismatch for sequence length distribution.
  - Action items: Priya to log kernel profiler traces and attach to GH issue; Diego to try alternate kernel set in a canary node by 5/10.
  - Customer ask: experimental commit of quantization recipe (low-risk) — requires documented rollback steps. Samir to draft rollback snippet.

3) Cross-customer risks and capacity
- Headcount: two senior SEs available 5/19 week; propose assignment: Nebula (1.0 FTE pre-prod), ArgosPay (0.5 FTE for trace engineering + 0.3 FTE for perf tuning), TidalAnalytics (0.5 FTE bench/quant). Evelyn to publish assignments by 5/09.
- Infra: staging GPU quota at 72% used; if ArgosPay runs full suite and Tidal runs quant experiments, we need temporary burst quota request for 5/12–5/14. Maya to open infra ticket and cc infra on quota request (JIRA: PRO-789).
- Escalation lane: if KMS/HSM requires host OS changes, escalate to platform-eng and security; expected lead time 2–3 weeks.

4) Operational items / small wins
- Samir: PR for onboarding automation (runtime onboarding script) opened — reviewers Diego + Priya. PR link in linked_artifacts. If merged, reduces manual checklist time by ~30m per onboarding.
- Diego: implemented route-specific trace sampling in a dev branch; initial tests look promising — will deploy to staging once PR reviews done.

5) Decisions made on call
- We will not delay Nebula go-live today — proceed with parallel path: continue cloud-KMS plan while scoping HSM work; escalate only if Nebula security signs off on HSM requirement.
- Approve temporary trace full-sample toggles for ArgosPay for triage window (5/08–5/12). Diego to revert after verification.

6) Action owners & deadlines (condensed)
- Evelyn: schedule security deep-dive with Nebula & internal security (due 2025-05-08).
- Diego: route-specific sampling toggle in staging (due 2025-05-08); HSM runbook excerpt (due 2025-05-09).
- Priya: update onboarding checklist with KMS/HSM decision matrix (due 2025-05-09); kernel profiler traces for TidalAnalytics (due 2025-05-10).
- Samir: finalize onboarding automation PR review (due 2025-05-07); run ArgosPay rerank suite and upload results (due 2025-05-09); draft Tidal rollback snippet (due 2025-05-10).
- Maya: open infra quota ticket (PRO-789) and coordinate with infra for burst (due 2025-05-07).

7) Notes to self / open questions (informal)
- Check whether our private deploy templates already include toggles for HSM vs cloud-KMS — looks like fragmentary support; need canonical decision flow.
- Should we formalize a small "fast-fail" policy for HSM requests that would automatically recommend a Dedicated timeline if lead time > 10 business days?
- Follow up: propose a 30-min deep-dive dedicated to Nebula security next week; avoid mixing with normal sync.

8) Next sync & format
- Next focused checkpoint: 2025-05-13 (30m) — format: 10m pulse, 15m deep-dive on Nebula, 5m wrap.
- If any blocker surfaces that blocks go-live, trigger escalation call (ad-hoc).

Attachments / quick links:
- onboarding-runbook-482 (Confluence) — checklist and runbook
- SE-2345 (JIRA) — KMS/HSM mismatch details
- PRO-789 (JIRA) — infra quota/burst request
- GH PR: runtime/pull/432 — onboarding automation

Raw meeting snippets / shorthand (copied from sticky notes):
- "Nebula: need HSM or sign-off; security deep-dive -> Evelyn to lead"
- "Argos traces: noise -> route sampling toggle; revert after triage"
- "Tidal: memory spike at long contexts; try kernel swap"

End of notes.

Refs: tag this doc with customer codenames for search (Nebula, ArgosPay, TidalAnalytics).
